releaseNotes: ## What's new
- Release script: safe entry-point check plus validated CLI arguments
- Release workflow: pin explicit SDK packages, drop obsolete tools default
- Automated releases: GitHub pipeline, App Store page, live release metadata, in-app updater
- QR device linking: show QR and scan to connect in Cloud database
- Add Stockly Android APK download to website store
- History detail: hero presence, wrapping names, richer related rows
- Product detail: richer description and stock history sections
- History detail: product info section plus roomier rows
- History detail: more spacing below toolbar on desktop
- Transaction detail: labeled desktop back button, roomier top spacing
- Desktop responsiveness polish, product categories, dialog a11y fixes
- bug fixes

- Replaced the generic JSON parse error with separate, safe messages for access failures, sign-in pages, unexpected HTML, malformed JSON, server errors, and Apps Script errors. Validated saved backend URLs against the deployed script.google.com/macros/s/.../exec format in Settings and before requests. Added upstream status, content type, redirect, and host diagnostics to the Vercel proxy without logging response bodies or full URLs. Preserved the fallback for older Apps Script deployments that do not support sync. Added nine response and URL validation tests.
- Vercel: serve /__stockly_api via rewrite to serverless proxy
- Web hosting: Vercel serverless API proxy with auto-detection
## Details
- Version: 1.0.0 (versionCode 1)
- Build: debug-signed
- Note: debug-signed sideload build. Configure release-signing secrets for store-signed APKs (see workflow file header).
